notInCrisis.you: I'm not in crisis. I don't need help.
notInCrisis.us: You don't need to be in crisis or to want help, sometimes it can just be nice to talk to someone who'll listen.

anonymity.you: I don't want my name on anything.
anonymity.us: You don't have to give one. Chat, text, and email are anonymous by default.

justVent.you: I just want to vent, not get advice.
justVent.us: You can talk to us. We're here to listen.

about.heading:
People who

can help.
about.p1: We are trained responders that work in collaboration with the Action Research on Social Polarisation (RAPS) team in Montréal, a multi-disciplinary team offering services that include social support, community engagement, psychotherapy, psychiatry, and access to medical services.
about.p2: In conjunction with regional partners, we provide support to individuals and families throughout Québec who are affected by the present social climate, which causes distress to many.

hours.a: Phone: 5 p.m. 9 p.m., every day. Email and text are monitored 24 hours and we reply within a day. Live chat is open whenever a responder is online usually during phone hours.

languages.a: We respond in English and French. Let us know which you prefer when you reach out or just write in whichever feels easier.

location.q: Do I have to live in Quebec?
location.a: No. We're based in Quebec but we won't turn you away if you're elsewhere. We may suggest a service closer to you if it's a better fit.

afterReachOut.q: What happens after I reach out?
afterReachOut.a: A trained responder reads or answers your message and replies. There's no intake form, no diagnosis, no referral pipeline. You decide what happens next.

callback.q: Will you call me back if I don't answer?
callback.a: Only if you explicitly asked us to. Otherwise we wait for you to come back when you're ready.
